name: Hosted Solr
description: Search API Solr connector for the Hosted Solr (SaaS) service with prefilled HTTPS/basic-auth settings.
project_description:
Search API Solr connector for hosted-solr.com .

 Hosted Solr automatically manages your Apache Solr indexes. Individual search indexes can be activated, deactivated or deleted at the click of a mouse.

 The Hosted Solr architecture is designed to operate with search indexes of any size. Whether you want to run a large corporate website or expand the home page of a local

business with a search function, Hosted Solr adapts to your needs.

 The search indexes are monitored, guaranteeing the highest availability for your search.

Our Hosted Solr user interface is designed for simple, intuitive operation.

 
 Note:

 Markus Kalkbrenner just created this connector as plugin for the Search API Solr module as third party integration to ease the configuration for this service. He's neither employed at Hosted Solr nor he's the owner or running this service.

 There are daily tests using the latest development versions of all modules of the eco system:

 https://github.com/mkalkbrenner/hosted_solr/actions
